dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: Gah, you have no idea, mate. The water here is deep as all sin, and while the waves are calm on the surface, the depths are full of hungry undercurrents.

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: The last time I went out to collect debts, the biggest gang in the Fleuve Cendre nearly had my head for it. The time before that, it took me until the end of my mission to realize the person I was chasing was being shielded by my own ruddy boss...

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: I mean, just look at me! Just why would they send a young rookie with no connections to a troublesome dirthole like Nod-Krai? If something goes wrong, my salary might not even be able to cover my medical bills.

dialogues.speaker: Kudratov
dialogues.text: Argh... I just want to go back to Morepesok and raise some deer in peace. Not like animals can just suddenly turn into a Fatui Harbinger and give me the tongue lashing of my life... Or so I hope.
